# Live 5 News

> > Live 5 News delivers local journalism, weather coverage, and community services to the Charleston, South Carolina region.

Live 5 News (WCSC) is a Charleston-based news outlet providing breaking news, weather updates via Sky 5 aerial coverage, and the Home Pros contractor directory for the Lowcountry community. The site serves South Carolina residents with local reporting on crime, business, transportation, and community events.

## Multimedia & Weather Coverage

- [Sky 5](https://www.live5news.com/video-gallery/weather/sky-5): Sky 5 aerial video gallery featuring Charleston landmarks and weather coverage via drone and aerial footage

## Community Services

- [Home Pros](https://www.live5news.com/homepros): Live 5 Home Pro contractor directory and professional services network connecting Charleston residents with vetted home improvement professionals
